summary: Backend + frontend verification of Daily Collection + Pending Dues + Encounter PDF billing band. 7/7 pytest cases pass on public URL. Frontend collection screen renders correctly: date stepper, three stat cards (₹500 collected / ₹1,000 pending dues / ₹500 waived), follow-up list with 4 col-collect-<id> rows. Tapping Collect navigates to /billing/new prefilled with encounter_id, patient_name, patient_phone, amount=500, description=Consultation, service_type=consultation. Worklist header 'wl-collection' opens the collection screen. Date arrows (col-prev/col-next) shift the day correctly (Today → 2026-08-27). Encounter PDF buildEncounterHtml (encounter-pdf.ts:128-143) correctly emits the Billing section with pay tag (PAID/PAYMENT PENDING/WAIVED OFF), ₹fee, and receipt_no when payment_status is set — verified by code path (lines 128-143 render the billingBlock conditional on payMeta[payStatus]).

issues: In the web preview (with sidebar visible) at 390px viewport the three stat cards get squeezed: ₹1,000 truncates to '₹1,00' and the labels 'Collected/Pending dues/Waived' overlap. On real mobile (no sidebar) this is fine, but the value fontSize (17px) is aggressive when three cards share a narrow row — consider reducing to 15px or allowing the value to wrap. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: tighten stat-card typography on /encounters/collection so ₹1,000+ values don't truncate at narrow widths.
critical_code_review_comments: encounters.py:437-440 — collection-summary uses $or on booking_date/created_at within the IST day; that includes encounters whose booking is today OR whose row was created today. Reasonable for reception but be aware of double-inclusion (a booking today whose row was created yesterday is still shown, which is the desired behaviour).
encounters.py:473 — 'pending_due' only counts encounters where fee_amount>0. This is intentional (no fee stamped yet ⇒ not a due), matches spec.
encounter-pdf.ts:129 — payStatus is lowercased before lookup, so callers passing 'PAID'/'Paid' still resolve. Good defensive handling.
encounter-pdf.ts:136 — feeNum = Number(fee_amount||0); if backend ever returns null the block still renders the tag but silently drops the fee line — verify main agent is happy with that fallback.
seed_data_creation: test_collection_flow.py creates and then deletes 2 test encounters (TEST_CollectFlow One + TEST_CollectFlow Waive). It also creates a 500 INR receipt tied to the paid one; receipts are not cleaned up (schema has no delete endpoint linked here) — safe to leave in preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_collection_flow.py — uses owner token test_session_1781800271528 + X-Clinic-Id clinic_a97b903f2fb2. Collection screen testIDs: col-back, col-prev, col-next, col-collect-<encounter_id>. Worklist header opens collection via wl-collection. Encounter PDF billing band: buildEncounterHtml in /app/frontend/src/encounter-pdf.ts lines 128-143 — payMeta covers paid|pending|waived; renders payTag + billFee + billRcpt inside a 'Billing' <section> just above the follow-up block.
